body: Flag: SEVERE. Gensol Engineering (solar EPC; EV leasing to sister company BluSmart, both promoted by the Jaggi brothers) was a 2022-24 smallcap multibagger. SEBI's interim order (15-Apr-2025) found prima facie that of ~Rs 978 cr borrowed from IREDA and PFC to buy 6,400 EVs for BluSmart, only ~4,704 were bought (~Rs 568 cr); funds were round-tripped via the vehicle supplier and related entities to promoters' uses (incl. a luxury DLF Camellias apartment and personal spending); promoters treated the listed company 'like a personal piggy bank'; letters purportedly from lenders submitted to rating agencies (CARE, ICRA) were allegedly forged; SEBI barred the Jaggis from the market and from director roles and halted a stock split. SEBI confirmed the interim directions (Jul-2025); the Jaggis resigned from the board. IREDA's petition admitted Gensol into insolvency (Jun-2025, ~Rs 510 cr default); NCLT Ahmedabad admitted BluSmart (Jul-2025). CBI registered an FIR (31-Jul-2025) over alleged misappropriation of IREDA loans (~Rs 672 cr cited); ED searches/forex probe; MCA examination. Criminal cases are pending. Early signals visible in 2024: rating-agency downgrades to default after 'forged' no-default letters were questioned, related-party leasing to the sponsor's unlisted startup, preferential allotments and a stock split proposal amid soaring price, and rapid debt growth versus cash flow.

data.regulator_findings: SEBI interim Apr-2025, confirmed Jul-2025 (fund diversion)
data.status_2026: Gensol and BluSmart in CIRP; CBI/ED cases pending

title: Gensol / BluSmart (Anmol & Puneet Singh Jaggi) — governance history
